title: Seat Rate Asked of a Guest for an Additional Driver, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
The seat rate is the share of the level's additional driver fee the guest is actually asked for on a Keyturn
Guest Protection Plan election. Which share applies is read from the guest's own trip ledger on the Keyturn
Trip Booking, in which the trip base rate appears as a base rate charged and a cancellation appears as a
cancellation fee charged.

1. Where the guest's trips have carried the trip base rate to 7500.00 USD or more over the last twelve months
   and no cancellation fee has been charged to the guest in that time, the seat rate is 0.70 of the level's
   additional driver fee, which is seventy hundredths of it.
2. Where the guest's trips have carried the trip base rate to 3000.00 USD or more over the last twelve months
   and no cancellation fee has been charged to the guest in that time, the seat rate is 0.85 of that fee.
3. In every other case the seat rate is 1.00 of that fee, the whole of it.

## Both sides of each threshold, and both sides of the cancellation condition

| Trip base rate charged over the last twelve months | Cancellation fee charged in that time | Seat rate |
|---|---|---|
| 7500.00 USD or more | None | 0.70 |
| 7500.00 USD or more | One or more | 1.00 |
| 3000.00 USD or more, under 7500.00 USD | None | 0.85 |
| 3000.00 USD or more, under 7500.00 USD | One or more | 1.00 |
| Under 3000.00 USD | Either | 1.00 |

The thresholds are met at the figure itself. A guest whose trip base rate charges over the last twelve months
come to exactly 7500.00 USD, with no cancellation fee charged in that period, is asked 0.70; one penny short of
that figure, and otherwise identical, the same guest is asked 0.85, being still at or above 3000.00 USD. A
guest whose charges come to exactly 3000.00 USD with no cancellation fee is asked 0.85; at 2999.00 USD the same
guest is asked the whole fee.

## Worked on a hypothetical ledger

A guest whose Keyturn Trip Booking ledger shows 8200.00 USD of trip base rate charged over the last twelve
months and one cancellation fee charged eight months ago is asked the whole of the level's additional driver
fee, because the cancellation condition is not met at either of the two rates above the standard one.
